summaries.9371ddc4-1b53-47b8-9020-a4637c32230d: Bryce Butler went 2-2 at 120 pounds at the 2026 Super 32, not placing at the tournament. He earned wins over Qwyntan Dyer of Tennessee (6-5) and J. Mako Vezzosi of New Jersey (9-7). Butler lost to Devin Hord of North Carolina, a 2026 Fargo 16U Freestyle All-American (5th), by decision 12-6.
summaries.582bca94-5f72-4ef1-ac0f-68098e44b931: Tristan Mobley went 2-2 at the 2026 Super 32 at 175 pounds, not placing at the tournament. He beat Chad McConnell, a 2x NHSCA All-American (2024 freshman, 2025 sophomore), by fall 4-3 in 4:34, and Ryker Hobbs by technical fall 18-1. Mobley lost to Jake Maddox, a 2024 NHSCA freshman All-American and 2025 CT Open State 3rd, by fall 3-0.
summaries.f89bd5d5-8827-4881-8857-942ffda049e7: Ethan Adams went 1-2 at 138 pounds at the 2026 Super 32, not placing at the tournament. He beat Kash Michael Mireles of Michigan by major decision, 9-0, and lost to Alexander Knowles of Wisconsin by technical fall.
summaries.66a76fdb-424b-4910-95c0-c04a68d10ecf: Trey Robinson went 1-2 at 215 pounds at the 2026 Super 32 and did not place. He beat Shane Montgomery of Pennsylvania, 9-3, and lost to Liam Rodebush, a 2026 Idaho 6A State 4th and 2026 NHSCA sophomore All-American, by medical forfeit.
summaries.aabcad2b-b455-412a-83be-9715f4125342: Brody Lawson went 0-2 and did not place at the 2026 Super 32 at 144 pounds. He lost to Gregory Jackson of Florida, a 2026 FL 3A State 3rd, by decision 9-3, and to Kendall Lewis of Tennessee, a 2026 TN AA State 3rd, by decision 10-6.
summaries.c46662cf-14af-42ce-81ef-9daf7895f4d2: Carson Sturgess went 0-2 and did not place at the 2026 Super 32 at 126 pounds. He lost to Sean Elliott of New Jersey, a 2026 NJ Open State 7th and 2025 Beast of the East 7th at 126, by technical fall 15-0 in 3:05, and to Christopher Phillips of Alabama by fall 18-0 in 4:16.
summaries.e0b247c2-de58-4450-9b8a-e25d55145505: Cooper Smythe went 0-2 and did not place at the 2026 Super 32 at 138 pounds. He lost to Wyatt Ulrey of Indiana, a 2026 IN State 5th, by fall 11-7 in 2:56, and to Cooper Mariakis of Georgia by technical fall 16-1 in 2:50.
summaries.71e0fbea-b1bc-4655-86f9-df8b199c2add: Devante Carter went 0-2 and did not place at the 2026 Super 32 at 144 pounds. He lost to Connor Reece of NC, a 2025 NHSCA freshman All-American (7th, 132), by fall in 0:14, and to Erik Carlile of PA by technical fall.
summaries.e398eb3f-8e6f-4e49-9cd1-1497cd966772: Stiles Stevens went 0-2 at 120 pounds at the 2026 Super 32 and did not place at the tournament. He lost to Julius Villamil of California by fall and to Will Hughes of Georgia by decision.
summaries.5d981ac0-2748-4b2d-adc5-af61fa9b8aca: Triston Johnson went 0-2 and did not place at the 2026 Super 32 at 138 pounds. He lost to Caleb Kosko of Pennsylvania, a 2026 PA AAA State 4th and 2026 NHSCA freshman All-American (3rd at 145), by fall (10-1, 3:00). Johnson also lost to Connor Niehaus of Ohio by fall (14-0, 3:00).
